release.name: Create GitHub Release
runs:
if [ "$GITHUB_REF_TYPE" = "tag" ]; then
VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
else
VERSION=$(node -p "require('./.claude-plugin/plugin.json').version")
fi
echo "value=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Releasing v$VERSION"

TAG_VERSION="${GITHUB_REF_NAME#v}"
PLUGIN_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./.claude-plugin/plugin.json').version")
if [ "$TAG_VERSION" != "$PLUGIN_VERSION" ]; then
echo "Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME does not match .claude-plugin/plugin.json version $PLUGIN_VERSION."
echo "Bump plugin.json to $TAG_VERSION, or retag as v$PLUGIN_VERSION, then release again."
exit 1
fi
echo "Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME matches plugin.json."

sync-10x.name: Sync 10x marketplace
runs:
if [ -z "$DISPATCH_TOKEN" ]; then
echo "TEN_X_DISPATCH_TOKEN secret not set; skipping 10x sync."
exit 0
fi
HTTP_CODE=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/dispatch.json -w "%{http_code}" -X POST \
-H "Authorization: token $DISPATCH_TOKEN" \
-H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
https://api.github.com/repos/Aboudjem/10x/dispatches \
-d "{\"event_type\":\"plugin-released\",\"client_payload\":{\"plugin\":\"contextify\",\"version\":\"$VERSION\"}}")
if [ "$HTTP_CODE" != "204" ]; then
echo "10x dispatch failed with HTTP $HTTP_CODE:"
cat /tmp/dispatch.json
echo "Rotate TEN_X_DISPATCH_TOKEN at https://github.com/Aboudjem/contextify/settings/secrets/actions"
exit 1
fi
echo "10x dispatch succeeded (HTTP 204)."

validate.name: Validate skill
runs:
git config --global user.name "Adam Boudjemaa"
git config --global user.email "boudjemaa.adam@gmail.com"

python3 - <<'PY'
import re, sys

path = "skills/contextify/SKILL.md"
try:
with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
text = f.read()
except FileNotFoundError:
print(f"FAIL: {path} not found")
sys.exit(1)

m = re.match(r"^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---\s*(?:\n|$)", text, re.DOTALL)
if not m:
print(f"FAIL: no YAML frontmatter block found in {path}")
sys.exit(1)
block = m.group(1)

# Minimal YAML parse for top-level 'name' and 'description'.
# Supports plain scalars and folded/literal block scalars (>- , | , etc.).
def parse_frontmatter(block):
data = {}
lines = block.split("\n")
i = 0
key_re = re.compile(r"^([A-Za-z0-9_-]+):\s*(.*)$")
while i < len(lines):
line = lines[i]
if not line.strip() or line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
i += 1
continue
if line[:1] in (" ", "\t"):
i += 1
continue
km = key_re.match(line)
if not km:
i += 1
continue
key, rest = km.group(1), km.group(2).strip()
if rest.startswith(("|", ">")):
collected = []
i += 1
while i < len(lines):
nxt = lines[i]
if nxt.strip() == "":
collected.append("")
i += 1
continue
if nxt[:1] in (" ", "\t"):
collected.append(nxt.strip())
i += 1
else:
break
data[key] = " ".join(c for c in collected if c != "").strip()
continue
val = rest
if len(val) >= 2 and val[0] == val[-1] and val[0] in ("'", '"'):
val = val[1:-1]
data[key] = val
i += 1
return data

fm = parse_frontmatter(block)
ok = True

name = fm.get("name", "")
# The Agent Skills spec: 1-64 chars, [a-z0-9-], and no leading, trailing or
# consecutive hyphens. The stricter pattern below rejects all three.
if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*", name or ""):
print(f"FAIL: 'name' must match ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$ "
f"(no leading, trailing or consecutive hyphens; got: {name!r})")
ok = False
elif len(name) > 64:
print(f"FAIL: 'name' must be <= 64 chars (got {len(name)})")
ok = False
elif name != "contextify":
print(f"FAIL: 'name' must be 'contextify' to match skills/contextify/ (got {name!r})")
ok = False
else:
print(f"PASS: 'name' is valid ({name!r})")

desc = fm.get("description", "")
if not desc or not desc.strip():
print("FAIL: 'description' must be non-empty")
ok = False
elif len(desc) > 1024:
print(f"FAIL: 'description' must be <= 1024 chars (got {len(desc)})")
ok = False
else:
print(f"PASS: 'description' is valid ({len(desc)} chars)")

if not ok:
sys.exit(1)
print("PASS: frontmatter check passed")
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import re, subprocess, sys

files = subprocess.run(
["git", "ls-files"],
capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
).stdout.splitlines()

# Provider-specific, length-anchored patterns: broad enough to catch a real
# leak, narrow enough not to fire on prose that merely mentions a prefix.
PATTERNS = [
("AWS access key id", re.compile(r"AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}")),
("private key header",
re.compile(r"-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH |DSA |PGP )?PRIVATE KEY-----")),
("GitHub personal access token", re.compile(r"ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}")),
("GitHub fine-grained token", re.compile(r"github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{22,}")),
("GitHub OAuth/app/refresh token", re.compile(r"gh[osur]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}")),
("Anthropic API key", re.compile(r"sk-ant-[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{24,}")),
("OpenAI-style API key", re.compile(r"sk-(?:proj-)?[A-Za-z0-9]{32,}")),
("Slack token", re.compile(r"xox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}")),
("Slack webhook", re.compile(r"https://hooks\.slack\.com/services/[A-Za-z0-9/+]{20,}")),
("Google API key", re.compile(r"AIza[0-9A-Za-z_\-]{35}")),
("Stripe secret key", re.compile(r"sk_live_[0-9a-zA-Z]{24,}")),
("npm token", re.compile(r"npm_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}")),
("Supabase service-role JWT", re.compile(r"eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{10,}\.eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{40,}\.[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{20,}")),
]

findings = []
for path in files:
if path.startswith(".git/") or path == ".git":
continue
try:
with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
data = f.read()
except (IsADirectoryError, FileNotFoundError, OSError):
continue
for ln, line in enumerate(data.splitlines(), 1):
for kind, rx in PATTERNS:
if rx.search(line):
findings.append((path, ln, kind))

if findings:
print("FAIL: potential secret(s) found:")
for path, ln, kind in findings:
print(f"  {path}:{ln}: {kind}")
sys.exit(1)
print(f"PASS: no credentials matched {len(PATTERNS)} secret patterns in tracked files")
PY

set -o pipefail
shopt -s nullglob
fail=0
for f in assets/*.svg assets/*.html; do
if grep -q '<script' "$f"; then
echo "FAIL: <script> found in $f"; fail=1
fi
if grep -Eq 'href="https?:|xlink:href="https?:|<image|@import|url\(https?:|src="https?:' "$f"; then
echo "FAIL: external reference found in $f"; fail=1
fi
case "$f" in
*.svg)
python3 -c "import xml.dom.minidom,sys; xml.dom.minidom.parse('$f')" \
&& echo "PASS: $f is well-formed, script-free, self-contained" \
|| { echo "FAIL: $f is not well-formed XML"; fail=1; }
if ! grep -Eq '@keyframes|<animate|<set[ >]' "$f"; then
echo "PASS: $f is static; no motion guard needed"
elif grep -q 'prefers-reduced-motion' "$f"; then
echo "PASS: $f honours prefers-reduced-motion"
else
echo "FAIL: $f has no prefers-reduced-motion guard"; fail=1
fi
;;
*) echo "PASS: $f is script-free and self-contained" ;;
esac
done
exit $fail

# Local hooks cannot cover every path: `git rebase` does not run commit-msg,
# `--no-verify` skips it, and squash-merges done on github.com, the GitHub API
# and Actions never touch a local hook at all. This is the backstop that does.
#
# It matches attribution TRAILERS only. Prose naming Claude Code is expected and
# allowed here, because this repository is a Claude Code plugin.
RANGE="${{ github.event.before }}..${{ github.sha }}"
if [ -z "${{ github.event.before }}" ] || ! git rev-parse -q --verify "${{ github.event.before }}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
RANGE="$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD | tail -1)..HEAD"
fi
echo "Scanning $RANGE"
BAD=$(git log --format='%H%x09%B' "$RANGE" 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E \
-e '^[[:space:]]*Claude-Session:[[:space:]]' \
-e '^[[:space:]]*Co-?Authored-?By:[[:space:]]*Claude' \
-e '^[[:space:]]*Co-?Authored-?By:.*@anthropic\.com' \
-e '^[[:space:]]*(Generated|Co-created) with .*Claude' || true)
if [ -n "$BAD" ]; then
echo "::error::AI attribution trailer found in a commit message."
echo "$BAD"
echo ""
echo "Fix: git rebase -i and reword, or install the global hook:"
echo "  git config --global core.hooksPath ~/.config/git/hooks"
exit 1
fi
echo "No AI attribution trailers found."

set -euo pipefail
asset="gitleaks_${GITLEAKS_VERSION}_linux_x64.tar.gz"
url="https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v${GITLEAKS_VERSION}/${asset}"
echo "Downloading $url"
curl -fsSL -o /tmp/gitleaks.tar.gz "$url"
tar -xzf /tmp/gitleaks.tar.gz -C /tmp gitleaks
chmod +x /tmp/gitleaks
/tmp/gitleaks version
/tmp/gitleaks dir . --no-banner --redact --exit-code 1

if command -v claude >/dev/null; then
# Root CLAUDE.md is contributor context, not distributed plugin context.
# The plugin validator warns about that intentional self-dogfood file.
claude plugin validate . --strict && claude plugin validate ./.claude-plugin/plugin.json
else
echo "claude CLI not on the runner; validate locally before tagging a release"
fi
